description:
Status of a job: queued, running, succeeded or failed. With `wait_seconds` it answers as soon as the
        job finishes, or after that long (at most 20 s): fewer calls while a big file is fetched.

        While it is on its way it says the step (`stage`), bytes done, jobs ahead of it (`queue_ahead`), a
        measured time left (`eta_s`) and `next_step`. When it has succeeded it also says whether a free download is
        possible (`free`) and what a fast one would cost in traffic bytes (`fast`).

job_id.description: Job id from start_download or download
job_id.title: Job Id

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this long (at most 20 s) for it to finish before answering
wait_seconds.title: Wait Seconds
